This is the second application filed by the Applicant under Section 483 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 19733 seeking regular bail in FIR No. 88/2023, registered at P.S. Maidan Garhi for the offences under Sections 376/376D/354/323/498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.4 2.

Mr. Vikram Singh Dalal, counsel for the Applicant, submits that subsequent to the dismissal of the Applicant's earlier bail application [BAIL APPLN. 2159/2023] by this Court on 08th August,
2023, there has been a "Cr.P.C."

sentences.text: 1 statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded, which, according to him, reveals material contradictions in the case of the prosecution.
In view of these developments, he argues that material change in circumstances entitles the Petitioner to apply for bail afresh.
3. Accordingly, Mr. Dalal seeks leave to withdraw the present application with liberty to apply for bail before the Sessions Court.

4. Dismissed as withdrawn with a liberty to the aforesaid.
5.
If and when such an application is filed before the Sessions Court, the same shall be considered on its own merits, in accordance with law.
6. The Court has not commented on the merits of the case.
All right and contentions of the parties are left open.
SANJEEV NARULA, J SEPTEMBER 2, 2025/MK
